spans.s:
प्लक्षः [प्लक्ष्यते कीटैः प्लक्ष्-कर्मणि घञ्]
1
{1} The Indian fig-tree; प्लक्षप्ररोह इव
सौधतलं बिभेद

; 13. 71.
--2
One of the seven Dvīpas or
continents of the world.
--3 A side or
back-door, a private entrance.
--4
The space at the side of a door.
--Comp.
--जाता, --समुद्रवाचका an
[]
epithet of the river Sarasvatī.
--तीर्थ,
प्रस्रवणं, -राज् m. the place where
the Sarasvatī rises.

प्लव a. [प्लु-अच्]
1 Swimming,
floating.
--2 Jumping, leaping.
--3 Ved.
Superior, excellent.
--वः
1 Swimming, floating.
--2 Flood, swelling
of a river.
--3 A jump, leap.
--4 A
raft, float, canoe, small boat;
नाशयेच्च शनैः पश्चात्प्लवं सलिलपूरवत्

.
--5 A frog.
--6 A monkey.
--7 A declivity, slope.
--8 An enemy.
--9 A sheep.
--10 A man of a low
tribe; a Cāṇḍāla.
--11 A net or snare
for catching fish.
--12 The fig-tree.
--13 The Kāraṇḍava bird, a kind of
duck.
--14 Five or more stanzas
syntactically connected. (= कुलक q. v.)
--15 The prolated utterance of a
vowel.
--16 Returning, return.
--17
Urging on, inciting.
--Comp.
--गः {1} a monkey;

. {2}
[]
a frog. {3} an aquatic bird, the
diver. {4} the tree शिरीष. {5} N.
of the sun's charioteer.
--(गा) the
sign of the zodiac called Virgo.
--गतिः a frog.

प्लवकः [प्लु ब हु˚ अक]
1 A frog.
--2
A jumper, tumbler, rope-dancer.
--3
The holy fig-tree.
--4 A Cāṇḍāla,
an outcast.
--5 A monkey.

1 An ape, a monkey.
--2 A
deer.
--3 The fig-tree.

1 A monkey; Śi. 12. 55.
--2 A frog. --Comp.
--इंदुः an
epithet of Hanumat.

प्लवन^1 a. [प्लु-ल्युट्] Inclined,
stooping down.
--नं
1 Swimming.
--2
Bathing, plunging into;

.
--3 Flying.
--4 Jumping,
leaping.
--5 A great flood, deluge.
--6
A declivity.
--7 One of a horse's
paces (capering).
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170203. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: adjective.

प्लविक a. [प्लवेन तरति ठन्] Taking
over in a boat, a ferry-man.

प्लावः [प्लु-घञ्]
1 Flowing over.
--2
Jumping, leaping.
--3 Filling to,
overflowing.
--4 Straining a liquid
(to remove impurities &c.);

प्लावनं [प्लुणिच् ल्युट्]
1 Bathing,
ablution.
--2 Overflowing, flooding,
inundating.
--3 A flood, deluge.

प्लावित p. p. [प्लु णिच् क्त]
1 Made
to swim, float, or overflow.
--2
Deluged, inundated, overflowed.
--3
Moistened, wetted, sprinkled;
Śi. 12. 26;

प्लाविन् a. [प्लु-णिनि]
1 Spreading
over, deluging, overflowing.
--2
Promulgating. --m. A bird.
